text:
incident-bot: Pager activated for apigw-prod — elevated 502/504 rate and upstream timeouts. Priority: P1. Link: https://incidents.internal/2765438901
jamie (oncall): I'm on. assembling ops channel, will take lead for 30m. tagging @maria @alex.
alex (infra): seeing spike concentrated in eu-west-1 edge nodes. 5m error rate ~9.8% (baseline ~0.3%). p95 latency from edge -> model-svc jumped to 1.4s.
maria (sre): adding runbook ingress-502. first checks: upstream timeouts, connection pool exhaustion, DNS flaps.
leo (support): incoming tickets from EU customers reporting failed generation calls (502). ticket #2345 references call_id=abc-123.
jamie (oncall): can someone grab recent edge-proxy logs for 15m and grep 502/504? paste top errors.
alex (infra): running:
```
kubectl logs -l app=edge-proxy -n apigw --since=15m | egrep "502|504|upstream timeout" | tail -n 80
```
alex (infra): sample from logs:
```
2026-03-17T02:12:21Z ERROR upstream timeout: host model-svc-3.eu-west-1.svc.cluster.local:8080, context=client-conn, timeout=12.2s
2026-03-17T02:12:23Z WARN connection_reset upstream=10.0.5.23:8080 -> closed unexpectedly
```
maria (sre): model-svc pod churn + CPU saturation on eu-west hosts. ops-monitor: can you confirm pod restart counts?
ops-monitor: alert: model-svc eu-west pods: CPU avg=93%, 3/5 pods restarted in last 10m, OOM not yet observed. network retransmits spike on host eth0.
jamie (oncall): mitigations: 1) route portion of traffic to canary/model-srv-02 to relieve primary 2) enable circuit-breaker on edge-proxy for slow upstreams 3) temporarily disable streaming for EU to reduce long-lived connections. Alex — flip partial routing.
alex (infra): applied routing change: 25% traffic to model-srv-canary (smaller quantized variant) for eu-west. command ran: `redwood route update --svc model-svc --region eu-west-1 --canary-weight 25`
leo (support): pushing status update to status.redwood: "Elevated 5xx in EU region. Traffic rerouted to fallback, mitigations in progress. We will update in 15m."
maria (sre): enabling circuit-breaker on edge-proxy: adjusted upstream timeout to 2s, max concurrent to 50 per backend, retry window 10s. will monitor.
ops-monitor: post-reroute metrics: error rate dropped to 3.2% (5m), upstream latency improved. throughput stable.
alex (infra): initiating scale-up of model-svc in eu-west: overriding HPA to add +4 replicas (target replicas -> 9) to absorb burst. starting graceful rolling restarts of unhealthy pods.
jamie (oncall): good. validate customer impact: Leo, are there high-priority customers still impacted?
leo (support): a handful of EU customers still report intermittent 502s (~1% traffic). support is opening direct lines and issuing compensatory credits if degraded >30m.
maria (sre): still seeing some host-level network errors; working with infra to migrate pods off congested nodes. tagging netsvc for follow-up.
jamie (oncall): temporary mitigation sequence complete. keep this thread for minutes-to-resolution updates. next actions: (a) collect logs for postmortem, (b) run connectivity tests from edge to model cluster, (c) review kernel/network driver at host level.
ops-monitor: timeline note inserted to incident timeline.
jamie (oncall): thanks everyone. leaving a 40m watch and will handoff to overnight oncall if unresolved. :thumbsup:
